items.title: Black-box deterministic expectation estimation for constant-width ROBPs from hitting sets
items.author: Kuan Cheng; William M. Hoza
items.source_version: Official Theory of Computing18(21),2022-09-20 complete32-page publication and publisher author SourceZIP; mainTheorem1.7/completeSection3 detailedTheorem3.1 with source-local dependencies.
items.difficulty_reason: The sampler infers approximate ROBP states using suffix hitting tests without graph access; because this equivalence need not respect transitions, it uses a maximal-representative recurrence and separately controls merged states, H-unreachable states and rounding while retaining only two layers of width-w data.

proof_spans.label: EntireSection3 source-local reduction, correctness, efficient implementation and amplification proof
